admission.shape: a `---` envelope whose closing fence may carry trailing spaces/tabs, the closed `config.treeView` / `config.themeVariables.treeView` leaves, and node `icon(none)` / empty `icon()` suffixes
admission.width_policy: wide_240 admission only; narrow_40 measured live
admission.twin_rule: the twin is the same fixture with the frontmatter removed; the art above the footer must be cell-equal

selection.rule: the last tree-view fallbacks: the trailing-space closing fence with the closed namespace, and the empty `icon()` suppression form

review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial code review (fresh general-purpose agent, D-455 tree-view residual admission, 2026-11-24; round 1 REQUEST-CHANGES with a shared-classify fence blocker plus five findings, round 2 APPROVE after the header-scoped tolerance, the hardened mirror and the token fix)
review.note: The fence tolerance is scoped to a `treeView-beta` body so packet/cynefin/radar keep their pre-D-455 verdicts; the empty `icon()` form is the only node-shape change; the twin and partition arithmetic are pinned by the per-row gate.

expected_footer_lines: config.treeView.lineThickness=3 -> branch line weight; not applied
rows.ledger_note: the tree-view projection transcribes node rows verbatim and never draws icons, colour, line weight or pixel indentation, so the closed namespace leaves and the icon-suppression suffixes are inert; the footer discloses each accepted leaf

expected_footer_lines: config.treeView.showIcons=true -> icons are not drawn; not applied
